name: Orbital Settings
description: Design Graph of the Orbital Settings screen: PageHeader instance plus profile, about, paths, and actions section cards.

sourceSummary.label: Orbital styles and brushes (Surfaces, TextBlock, Buttons, OrbitalBrushes, Animations)

properties.layout: header row (Auto) over scrollable content (*); content is a responsive utu:AutoLayout (Spacing=24, Padding Narrow=16 / Normal=32 / Wide=32) with a full-width profile card above a two-column grid (left: about, right: paths + actions)

properties.columns: profile card full width; below it a two-column grid (* / 16 gap / *) — left column: about card; right column: paths and actions cards

title.realization: TextBlock x:Name=TitleText, style OrbitalPageTitle, set from Title dependency property

subtitle.realization: TextBlock x:Name=SubtitleText, style OrbitalBody with Foreground OrbitalText40Brush and FontWeight Normal, set from Subtitle dependency property

search-trigger.realization: tappable Border x:Name=SearchBorder (Surface1 background, Surface3 border, CornerRadius 8, Padding 12,8) containing FontIcon glyph E721, placeholder text 'Search or run command...' and a 'Ctrl+K' shortcut badge (Surface2 background, CornerRadius 4)

section-title.realization: uppercase TextBlock, style OrbitalSectionHeader, Foreground OrbitalText38Brush

body.realization: utu:AutoLayout content stack below the section title

properties.entrance: starts at Opacity 0 with TranslateTransform Y=8; faded up from code-behind on page Loaded

evidence.rationale: Four section Borders declare Style=OrbitalCardStyle with identical section-title + AutoLayout body structure.
